record.reason: MoSAIC-ReID applies LoRA experts with oracle routing to visual person re-identification and studies semantic-attribute importance on ReID benchmarks. The paper’s expert routing is for a vision retrieval task, not an LLM or language-model inference optimization; the linked general MoE connection is not a technical match.
record.title: What really matters for person re-identification? A Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Semantic Attribute Importance
